segment: Three cases whose historical runs had no accepted observation are executed on the current composition and accepted against their criterion

the_finding_about_the_historical_runs.what_the_registry_said: A-03, D-07, M-04, M-11, P-02 and P-04 carried attempts [], capability_status UNASSESSED and the next action 'Prepare specific valid fixture and select existing seam; bind candidate and finite budget before execution'.
the_finding_about_the_historical_runs.what_the_records_showed: the runs themselves exist and reached EVIDENCE_READY, but EVERY one of their observations carries response_binding NEW_NONCE_CONTRACT_UNBOUND_UNGRADED: they were recorded before the nonce binding of the reply text existed, so the acceptance never completed. The registry did not count them.
the_finding_about_the_historical_runs.what_was_done: the fixtures were restored byte for byte from the Jarvis workspace and their digests equal the ones the historical runs pinned. The three cases whose historical runs carried no ACCEPTED observation (P-02, P-04, M-11) were then executed again on the current composition under a fresh admission, which is what their registry entry asks for. The basis for the repeat is the MISSING ACCEPTANCE of the historical attempt, not the kind of the answer: a text answer is NOT by itself a reason to repeat, and an artefact answer is NOT by itself a reason to keep an unaccepted attempt. The two cases whose historical runs delivered an artefact to the chat (A-03 with core_inputs_roundtrip.zip, M-04 with Mayak_report_v1_full.docx) were NOT repeated: their effect already exists, and repeating the request would duplicate it.
the_finding_about_the_historical_runs.the_repeat_rule_that_is_withdrawn: the earlier reasoning that a case may be repeated because its obligation produces only a TEXT answer and no artefact is WITHDRAWN as a rule. The governing rule is the acceptance state of the attempt, never the shape of its answer: an attempt whose acceptance never completed may be executed again under a fresh admission; an attempt with an unknown effect (UNKNOWN_SEND, TRANSPORT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN) may NOT be resent; an attempt whose effect is established is not repeated. NOT_RUN and UNBOUND_UNGRADED describe the ACCEPTANCE of an attempt. They do NOT mean that the request was never sent: the historical runs above DID reach the wire and DID produce observations, which is why they are UNBOUND_UNGRADED and not NOT_RUN. A new run id, a new admission, a restart or a changed composition do not by themselves make a repeat an independent operation.

the_executed_cases.observation: reply_text at message 2609, 1524 characters, accepted by the tester
the_executed_cases.the_criterion: retell the PDF whose first page is text and whose second page is a scan
the_executed_cases.the_criterion_of_the_registry: the registry oracle of this case is wider than the step above: 'Both layers processed through actual permitted local extraction/vision; no missing scanned page, no duplicate text from overlapping OCR layers.' The published verification below was checked against the first page only, so it did not cover the oracle as written.
the_executed_cases.the_answer: the answer names the two pages and their nature: page 1 has the native text layer, page 2 is a scan expanded by the local OCR, and it lists the columns and the rows 0001 - A01 - 2 - 1200,50 - 2401,00 and 0002 - B02 - 3 - 499,90 - 1499,70 together with the note that the table continues on page 2
the_executed_cases.the_verification: the fixture has exactly one page with a text layer and one page without it, and the text layer of page 1 carries the heading 'Заказы: лист 1 из 2', the note 'Синтетические учебные данные. Валюта: RUB.' and the two rows the answer gives
the_executed_cases.the_verification_of_the_second_page: the second page is verified from the ALREADY SAVED material, without any new request to the product. The fixture is evidence/P-02-P02_orders_hybrid.pdf, 54153 bytes, sha256 8d80ef2f6f5c443989803ace54f50052607cb30be83540deb3483f6cf953c5c3; the copy the product received in the chat is byte for byte the same file. Page 2 carries NO text layer: the only object on it is a /Subtype /Image of 1240x1754 px at 150 dpi, and no font. The saved answer 2609 (1524 characters, sha256 faa35b75...09bb8) DOES cover page 2: it names it as a scan read by the local OCR and gives the heading 'Заказы: лист 2 из 2', the subheading 'Синтетические учебные данные', the columns, both rows 0003 - А01 - 1 - 1200,50 - 1200,50 and 0004 - C03 - 2 - 2500,00 - 5000,00, and the total line 'Итого по двум листам: 10101,20 RUB'. The extraction record saved in the profile marks the page 2 tokens as unverified candidates (13 unverified numeric tokens, 3 low confidence tokens, ocr_exact false, numeric_values_verified false). An INDEPENDENT OCR of the same saved PDF reproduces every one of those numbers, and the arithmetic of the four rows closes exactly on the saved total: 2401,00 + 1499,70 + 1200,50 + 5000,00 = 10101,20. The rows of the two pages do not overlap (0001-0002 against 0003-0004), so there is no duplicate text from overlapping OCR layers. The only discrepancy is the article of row 0004: the answer wrote 'Co3' or 'C03' as indistinguishable, while a glyph-level reading of the saved raster shows the latin C, 0 and 3, that is C03; the product itself named both variants, so the answer did not assert a wrong value.
the_executed_cases.the_verdict_corrected: the criterion is met and every value in the answer is confirmed against the fixture, including the second page
the_executed_cases.the_verdict_corrected_detail: the semantic part of the oracle IS established by the saved material: the scanned page is not missing, both layers were processed by the permitted local extraction, and there is no duplicated text. The TESTER acceptance of R62 is a different matter and it did NOT happen: the tester recorded acceptance NOT_ESTABLISHED and reply_text_acceptance RECEIVED_UNGRADED, and there is no closure record for this run. The honest verdict is therefore: the second page is established in substance from the saved answer, the saved fixture and an independent OCR; the tester acceptance of the second page stays NOT_ESTABLISHED. The product's own extraction contract still marks the scanned numbers as UNVERIFIED - an independent OCR confirms them, it does not cancel that contract.
the_executed_cases.verdict: the criterion is met and every value in the answer is confirmed against the fixture; the tester acceptance of the run remains NOT_ESTABLISHED / RECEIVED_UNGRADED
